blocker_resolutions.implementation: Minimise full-duration squared policy-relative offset distance over all recorded-member actor subsets of size 1..4, all registered integer onset/hold windows, and analytically optimised continuous depth. Compare every shape with none. Include omitted members and zero padding through the latest allowed release. Family tags only break equal-distance ties.

Use stored perturbation_profile offsets, or subtract a finite, aligned, explicit policy_profile from absolute profile/legacy-knot commands. Reject missing references; never infer a baseline from the plan median. Preserve receipt/example wrappers and legacy executor interpolation/extrapolation semantics.

api.Move: Frozen Move(family, members, onset, hold, depth); actors property; to_dict()/from_dict()
api.candidates: candidates(obs_state, numpy.random.Generator, n) -> exactly n non-baseline Move objects
api.obs_state: self plus local observable sensing/V2V rows: vid, s_m, v_mps, lane, is_cav
api.offsets: offsets(move, t, state=None) -> {cav_id: acceleration_offset}; t is an integer elapsed second
api.offset_state: Optional original base commands, observable v_mps/allowed speeds, executor accel_bounds, and observable s_m for wall release
api.from_plan: from_plan(verified_plan) -> nearest Move; accepts bare plans, chosen_plan receipts, or own-plan examples
api.policy_reference: Stored perturbation_profile takes precedence. Absolute profile or legacy knots require policy_profile, a finite members x duration_s recorded policy-command matrix in the same member order and time frame. Missing or misaligned references raise ValueError.

semantics.members: 1..4 distinct CAV ids; online candidates include self, exclude HDVs, and restrict partners to the registered observable/V2V range
semantics.ranges_source: variety.VARIETY_REGISTERED: onset 0..30s, hold 20..90s, depth 0.3..1.0; integer-second windows
semantics.offset_shape: ease_off/gap_open ease members[0]; wall/ramp_assist ease all members; -depth during [onset,onset+hold), zero outside
semantics.projection_distance: Sum of squared offset errors over every original member and every recorded second, zero-padded through max(duration_s, maximum registered release); omitted members receive zero predicted offsets
semantics.projection_search: Enumerate actor subsets of size 1..4 and registered integer windows; continuous depth optimum clipped to the registered range. Equivalent single-actor shapes cover ease_off/gap_open; multi-actor shapes cover wall/ramp_assist. Gap_open uses the first other recorded member as its zero-offset partner.
semantics.projection_ties: none wins unless strictly improved; otherwise prefer matching variety_family, then FAMILIES order, smaller membership, plan member order, earliest onset and shortest hold
semantics.wall: Online candidates hold upstream within registered span and release by constant-speed observable arrival; current s_m state releases the wall at the merge boundary
semantics.clamp: With complete observable state, clip base+offset to existing acceleration/speed bounds and the 1.2 m/s^2 cap; return correction relative to original base. Infeasible seconds receive zero correction; none/release preserve base identity.
semantics.executor_contract: Without complete state offsets are nominal. The consuming single-writer executor must enforce feasibility and speedMode 27.

limitations: Absolute/legacy bank records without stored policy-relative offsets or an explicit aligned recorded policy reference are unsupported and rejected.
The single-window vocabulary is a nearest offset projection of richer multi-window profiles; offline labels do not establish online geometry, observability, certification or efficacy.
Online runtime integration and SUMO/WM efficacy verification belong to consuming tracks.
